title: PlanForge stack preferences
description: Which technologies the user prefers for each kind of app. Written by the preferences form (planning/questions.json drives it); read by the interview and planner prompts via renderPreferencesSummary(). Every group and field is optional — 'No preference' answers are simply omitted, and the planner then chooses boring, mainstream defaults and records them as decisions. Field values are free-form strings; the option lists in questions.json are suggestions, not enums.
